scenarios.assumptions:
The attacker profile gives physical access to B and the boot CD (N3 is the start node). There is no physical access to M, so N5 is not initially true and nothing produces it.
Source: Phillips, C. and Swiler, L. P. (1998). A Graph-Based System for Network-Vulnerability Analysis. Proc. 1998 New Security Paradigms Workshop (NSPW), pp. 71-79. Fig. 2 'Graph Generation Example' (p. 76) and its description in Section 3 (p. 75).
Transcription notes: Nodes N1-N5 and the goal are transcribed from the attack-graph part of Fig. 2 (p. 76); the Network Configuration and Attack Templates parts of the figure are not modelled. N4 and N5 are drawn dotted; the text (p. 75) says they are unreachable because the attacker has no physical access to M, so N5 has no producer and is false in the baseline. The goal is reachable along the path the figure draws (N3 -> N2 -> N1 -> goal); the paper states no path cost, so 3 is just the count of illustrative unit costs. The two edges N5->N4 and N4->goal have no labels in the graph; their names come from Template 2 (Reboot off the CD; access to users on X). Simplifications: N1 is an OR node over (user, machine) pairs and N2 is 'root on A or B'; each is one fact here. The text says the full graph would also have a node like N3 for machine A that is unreachable; it is not drawn and is omitted. The 'Physical access to M' scenario and its expected values are my own what-if, not in the paper.

semantics: Conditions are persistent Boolean facts; there are no delete effects or negation.
AND requires all incoming inputs; OR requires at least one. Unlabelled joins use the per-scenario AND/OR choice.
An action is enabled when its inputs hold (or it is an approved entry action); executing it assumes success.
Each action executes at most once; efforts are nonnegative, additive, and shared actions are charged once.
Minimum effort is an exact search over closed active sets; limits yield an incomplete result, never a minimum or unreachability.
importDefaults: New imports: root and declared starting conditions true; root actions allowed as entries.
New imports: unlabelled joins default to OR; missing efforts default to 1; goal = reachable node of greatest minimum dependency depth.
